verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents an OpenAI-compatible API (and Anthropic Messages/Open Responses API) that can be driven with any standard SDK, plus a documented functions/tools API and MCP-based agent tooling, all backed by first-party docs. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/swagger spec (probes show 404s on the marketing site) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
